Why do almost all tokens fail?

Let’s be honest. Most tokens don’t fail because the meme is bad or the project lacks potential. They fail because early investors accumulate too much of the supply, then dump their bags and drain the liquidity, leaving everyone else holding the bag.

But what if we could change that?

With Liquidy, we’re introducing a new standard for token launches: a system that turns trading fees into liquidity that is burned, buybacks, and long-term ecosystem growth.

💧 HOW LIQUIFY WORKS

100% of the creator fees generated by $LIQUIFY are put to work:

• 50% buys back $LIQUIFY.
• 50% stays in SOL.
Both assets are added to the liquidity pool and the LP is burned. Liquidity never leaves.

🚀 LAUNCH YOUR OWN TOKEN ON LIQUIFY

Anyone can launch a token on pumpfun through Liquify. Every token is paired with $LIQUIFY, so every buy from SOL routes through $LIQUIFY first. The fee structure is designed to benefit the token, not to generate revenue for the protocol.

For every token launched on Liquify, after bonding:

• 45% of fees buys back the launched token.
• 45% stays in $LIQUIFY.
• 10% of fees is burned in $LIQUIFY.

Both sides are added to the token’s PumpSwap liquidity pool and the LP is burned. Nothing waits in a wallet: every claim is deposited within a minute.
🌊 WHAT IF YOUR TOKEN HASN’T BONDED YET?
Liquidity doesn’t have to wait for bonding.

Before bonding, every fee your token generates is a buyback and burn:

• 90% buys back and burns your token.
• 10% is burned in $LIQUIFY.

Once your token bonds, the mechanism shifts to building its PumpSwap liquidity pool.

Every trade contributes. Every fee has a purpose. Every action is a public transaction you can verify on the Engine page.

XRAD is a token on the Solana network designed for the XTrading platform—a service for managing assets such as stocks, gold, and bonds, which also includes a trading bot for MetaTrader 4. Token holders can use XRAD to pay for platform access and to purchase the trading bot.
About the Token
XRAD is a Solana-based token created for the XTrading platform ,It was launched on the decentralized exchange Raydium with an initial pool of 1,000 tokens, priced at 0.002 SOL per unit. The total supply is capped at 21,000,000 tokens. The smart contract address (mint address) is: ixLdEKhYLs13iwqAMqqjDRCnMu7ZfDPpZQbgYEkykEd. The current market price is determined by the liquidity pool on Raydium. XRAD serves as a payment method for platform access and for acquiring the MetaTrader 4 trading bot. In the future, other tools on the platform will also be priced in XRAD. It is important to note that holding the token grants access to the product but does not guarantee any appreciation in the token's value.
About the Platform
XTrading is an analytical and trading platform. It tracks assets—including stocks, gold, and bonds—and provides recommendations on whether to add them to a portfolio, reduce holdings, or sell. The platform assesses market risks for gold, bonds, and stocks before market movements become apparent. Daily trading ideas (covering both intraday and 30-minute timeframes) are published, with each including specified entry levels, stop-loss points, and profit targets. These same 30-minute trading rules have been implemented in a bot for MetaTrader 4, which users can purchase and run on their own trading platforms. The project’s goal is to create a unified, intuitive ecosystem—encompassing asset portfolios, risk assessment, and trading signals triggered at specific levels—all powered by a single token on the Solana network: XRAD.

XTrading is an analytical and trading platform. It tracks assets—including stocks, gold, and bonds—and provides recommendations on whether to add them to a portfolio, reduce holdings, or sell. The platform assesses market risks for gold, bonds, and stocks before market movements become apparent. Daily trading ideas (covering both intraday and 30-minute timeframes) are published, with each including specified entry levels, stop-loss points, and profit targets. These same 30-minute trading rules have been implemented in a bot for MetaTrader 4, which users can purchase and run on their own trading platforms. The project’s goal is to create a unified, intuitive ecosystem—encompassing asset portfolios, risk assessment, and trading signals triggered at specific levels—all powered by a single token on the Solana network: XRAD.
